name: Bulk SEO Importer (Lite)
author: Roger Blumen

sections.description:
Bulk SEO Importer (Lite) streamlines SEO operations at scale by importing and exporting key fields via CSV:
– post_id (required)
– slug (optional)
– seo_title (optional)
– meta_description (optional)

It auto-detects the active SEO plugin and writes to the correct meta keys for Yoast, Rank Math, and AIOSEO. If no SEO plugin is active, it falls back to generic meta keys. Designed to be safe-by-default: nonces, capability checks, input validation/sanitization, and properly escaped admin output.

More features are available in the Pro version, including additional fields (canonical URL, focus keyword, social/OG/Twitter tags), custom post types, and more. Learn more: https://bulkseoimporter.com/pro

Features (Lite)

  • CSV Import of seo_title, meta_description, and slug by post_id.
  • CSV Export (Lite) with the same four columns for quick roundtrips.
  • SEO Plugin Detection: Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO meta keys handled automatically.
  • Security by Design: Nonces, capability checks (manage_options), validated uploads.
  • CSV-Injection Protection for exports (neutralizes leading =, -, +, @).
  • No External Calls: Operates entirely within your WordPress site.

More features in Pro

  • Additional SEO fields (e.g., canonical URL, social/OG/Twitter tags, focus keyword).
  • Support for custom post types.
  • Extended export options and filters.
    Learn more: https://bulkseoimporter.com

Usage

= CSV Format =
– Save as UTF-8 .csv with a header row.
– Required header: post_id
– Optional headers: slug, seo_title, meta_description
– Unknown columns are ignored.

Example header:
post_id,slug,seo_title,meta_description

Import behavior

  • Only updates the columns you include.
  • slug is sanitized; WordPress ensures uniqueness when needed.
  • If post_id does not exist or is invalid, that row is skipped.
  • If an SEO plugin is active, the plugin writes into its meta keys; otherwise, generic keys are used.

Export behavior

  • Streams a CSV with post_id, slug, seo_title, meta_description for posts and pages.
  • Uses CSV-injection protection for values starting with =, -, +, @.

Compatibility

  • Yoast: _yoast_wpseo_title, _yoast_wpseo_metadesc
  • Rank Math: rank_math_title, rank_math_description
  • AIOSEO: _aioseo_title, _aioseo_description
  • If no SEO plugin is detected, generic keys _seo_title and _meta_description are used.

Security & Privacy

  • Admin actions are protected with nonces and require manage_options capability.
  • File uploads are validated via wp_check_filetype_and_ext and is_uploaded_file.
  • No external requests, no license checks, and no telemetry in the Lite version.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Open Tools → Bulk SEO Import.
  3. Use Import to upload a CSV with a header row. post_id is required; include any of slug, seo_title, meta_description as needed.
  4. Use Export (Lite) to download a CSV containing the Lite columns for all posts and pages.
sections.faq:
Does it require an SEO plugin?

No. It works without one, writing to generic meta keys if no supported plugin is active.

Can I import only one field?

Yes. Include only the columns you want to change; others are ignored.

What about large CSVs?

Imports are processed server-side with standard WordPress constraints. If you hit server limits, try splitting the CSV into smaller batches.

Does it support custom post types?

The Lite version focuses on posts and pages. Pro adds CPT support. Details: https://bulkseoimporter.com/
